title: AppFlow readback mutex classification requires manual inventory edits
body: Adding AppFlowReadback.cpp caused no_new_mutex_check to fail because the borrowed Vulkan queue mutex needed an allowlist row and a separate runtime lock inventory acquisition index entry. I ran the queued no-new-mutex check with --fix, then manually classified VIXEN/application/editor/source/AppFlowReadback.cpp as VK2-borrowed and edited Vixen-Docs/01-Architecture/2026-09-08-runtime-lock-inventory-and-classification.md at application/editor/source/AppFlowReadback.cpp:269. Suggested consolidation: have the mutex checker emit or update the inventory classification in the same declarative step.

title: Editor capture witness needs explicit fixture executable preparation
body: The focused CTest run at /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1791584000-test-baseline-r6-test.log passed vixen_editor_capture_producer but failed because build/wsl/binaries/VIXEN was absent, so vixen_hud_capture_producer and the dependent R6 test did not run. I recovered by using the live queue for cmake --build build/wsl --target VIXEN test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_windowedcapture --parallel 4, then rerunning CTest. Suggested consolidation: provide an aggregate editor-gate preparation target or documented focused witness command that builds every executable consumed by its CTest fixtures.

title: VIXEN GPU test locking does not coordinate across CTest worktrees
body: During the queued combined editor witness, vixen_editor_capture_producer timed out at 180 seconds while another worktree's LookdevCapture.RendersFourStatesAtFourAnglesDeterministically CTest was concurrently using the same DZN device. The editor had only reached capture tick 115; the channel gate still passed but took 102.89 seconds and readback round trips ballooned to 6-10 seconds. A low-contention baseline editor producer completed in 20.28 seconds. I must wait for the other GPU test to finish and rerun the old gate. The RESOURCE_LOCK vixen_gpu_device in VIXEN/application/editor/CMakeLists.txt is local to one CTest process, so it does not serialize across worktrees. Suggested consolidation: make GPU device admission a global named resource in the shared box queue or its CTest wrapper.

title: VIXEN tools ignore rule hides required AppFlow client and gate files
body: The repo-wide VIXEN/.gitignore entry  ignores the new appflow_client.py, appflow_mcp_server.py, and appflow_channel_gate.py even though editor CMake registers the gate and the task requires the client/server. I must use git add -f for these required source deliverables so they are present in the lane commit. Suggested consolidation: narrow the ignore rule or add tracked-source exceptions for first-party tools and gates.
